description: Hand-authored expansion of the grouped design rows into individually named entries. Each entry names one API, construct, directive, macro or option and gives its status, which must be one of the row's statuses or X/E (stricter). kind 'vue' and 'macro' entries must agree with vue-exports.json (row and status); 'app' method entries are checked against a real app instance. Lookups use (kind, name); see docs/compatibility/README.md.

entries.name: var
entries.note: Var hoisting versus TDZ is covered by T02.

entries.name: sloppy script
entries.note: Non-module sloppy scripts are rejected by L01.

entries.name: annex-b
entries.note: Annex B legacy forms are rejected by L01.

entries.name: object accessor
entries.note: Getters and setters in object literals only.

entries.name: new
entries.note: User constructors and new-function constructors are excluded (L05).

entries.name: custom coercion
entries.note: User valueOf/toString and unsupported prototypes are rejected (L07).

entries.name: Symbol
entries.note: Subset: unique symbols and registry symbols.

entries.name: Math.random
entries.note: Comes from the injected random provider; never used for secrets.

entries.name: Date.now
entries.note: Comes from the injected clock provider.

entries.name: qualified npm import
entries.note: Static graph; package conditions and casing are checked.

entries.name: props destructure
entries.note: Reactive props destructuring transform for defineProps.

entries.name: defineOptions
entries.note: Only name and inheritAttrs; other keys are errors (S11).

entries.name: enum
entries.note: Use union constants or functions instead.

entries.name: ComponentCustomProperties
entries.note: Cannot enable excluded Options API or arbitrary globals (S22).

entries.name: tsconfig
entries.note: Strict checks and ESM resolution; native libraries omit DOM and Node.

entries.name: watchHandle.stop
entries.note: Method on the handle returned by watch.

entries.name: watchHandle.pause
entries.note: Method on the handle returned by watch.

entries.name: watchHandle.resume
entries.note: Method on the handle returned by watch.

entries.name: onCleanup
entries.note: Callback parameter of watch and watchEffect.

entries.name: useTemplateRef
entries.note: Native typed handle; DOM element handle on web.

entries.name: setup
entries.note: Only through defineComponent or an SFC; other Options API keys are rejected (V29).

entries.name: template expression
entries.note: Scoped expressions with the globals allowlist.

entries.name: v-bind
entries.note: Attributes, properties, class, style, object spread and dynamic arguments.

entries.name: v-on
entries.note: Adapted on native, P on DOM.

entries.name: .passive
entries.note: Passive applies only to supported web listeners (U06); rejected otherwise.

entries.name: .number
entries.note: Explicit native numeric textbox; empty and invalid values handled per U08.

entries.name: input (other HTML types)
entries.note: No generic catch-all input; unsupported types are errors.

entries.name: ref
entries.note: Stable component or host handles; function refs.

entries.name: component
entries.note: Dynamic lookup in a static module set.

entries.name: is (custom element)
entries.note: Arbitrary HTML custom elements are excluded (U19).

entries.name: custom directive
entries.note: Typed host handle with old and new values; no native pointers.

entries.name: v-cloak
entries.note: Loading selector on web; documented no-op on native.

entries.name: v-html
entries.note: Conservative: X by default. W applies only to an explicit web-only profile (open question).

entries.name: app.config.compilerOptions
entries.note: Compile-time only; runtime mutation is rejected.

entries.name: renderToString
entries.note: Exported by vue/server-renderer, not by vue; the native SSR interface is our own Rust API.

entries.name: renderToNodeStream
entries.note: Node Readable streams are not native APIs (A15).

entries.name: pipeToNodeWritable
entries.note: Node Writable pipes are not native APIs (A15).

entries.name: __VUE_OPTIONS_API__
entries.note: Options API is always off. Documented Vue flag; the pinned dist does not reference it (bundlers substitute it).

entries.name: __VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__
entries.note: Release builds exclude debug listeners. Documented Vue flag; the pinned dist does not reference it.

entries.name: __VUE_PROD_HYDRATION_MISMATCH_DETAILS__
entries.note: Profile-controlled. Documented Vue flag; the pinned dist does not reference it.

entries.name: computed
entries.note: Options API key; the Composition API computed is V06.

entries.name: watch
entries.note: Options API key; the Composition API watch is V14.

entries.name: provide
entries.note: Options API key; the Composition API provide is V24.

entries.name: inject
entries.note: Options API key; the Composition API inject is V24.

entries.name: table
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: caption
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: colgroup
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: col
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: thead
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: tbody
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: tfoot
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: tr
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: th
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: td
entries.note: Tables are excluded from the first profile; use the framework grid component instead (design 9.2, Layout).

entries.name: svg
entries.note: SVG DOM trees are not native tags; use an image asset (img) instead. SVG image assets are supported separately (design 9.2).

entries.name: video
entries.note: Media elements are a web-only extension (U32); use the web target instead.

entries.name: audio
entries.note: Media elements are a web-only extension (U32); use the web target instead.

entries.name: canvas
entries.note: Canvas is not a universal native tag (U32); use an image asset (img) instead.

entries.name: iframe
entries.note: Embedded web content is excluded (U32: no webview insertion); use a link (a) instead.

entries.name: template
entries.note: Template fragment element (U30). The SFC <template> block is S01.

entries.name: suspense
entries.note: Template tag for Suspense (U25); experimental and rejected by the production profile.
